title: Terms of sale
intro: These terms apply to the purchase of the full report of the {{bilan}} on quiz-couple.com. Everything else on the site is free and isn't covered by any sale.

vendeur.tvaValeur: VAT not applicable, article 293 B of the French General Tax Code

p: The couple check-up is a questionnaire that two partners each answer separately. Answering is free, and so is the overall result (agreement percentage, relationship forecast, a bar for each area, the number of gaps and one gap in full).

What is sold is the full report: all the couple's gaps with both answers, the guides to talking about them, the next four conversations, the sticking points and each partner's non-negotiables, what brings the couple together and the forecast question by question. The report is digital content, shown on the check-up page and printable.
The full report costs {{prix}}, VAT not applicable. It's a one-off payment, with no subscription. A single payment, made by either partner, unlocks the report for both.
The price is shown on the check-up page before the first question, and again before payment.

Payment is only offered once both partners have finished answering. Before paying, the buyer ticks a box requesting immediate access to the report and acknowledging that they lose their right of withdrawal once the report is unlocked (see article 5).

Payment is made on the secure page of our provider Stripe, by bank card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. We never have access to card details. Stripe sends a receipt to the email address given at payment: this is the order confirmation. An invoice can be requested from the {{contact}}.

The report opens as soon as payment is confirmed, on the check-up page, for both partners, from their personal links. It stays available for six months after payment, then the check-up is erased. It can be printed or saved as a PDF at any time.
Either partner can delete the check-up before then. Deletion is immediate and permanent, for both, and doesn't lead to a refund outside the guarantee in article 6.

The report is digital content supplied immediately after payment. In accordance with article 16(m) of Directive 2011/83/EU and article L221-28 13° of the French Consumer Code, the fourteen-day right of withdrawal doesn't apply once the report is unlocked, as the buyer requested immediate access and acknowledged losing this right before paying.

On top of what the law provides, we refund the report within {{jours}} days of payment, with no need to give a reason: just write to us from the {{contact}} giving both partners' first names and the date of payment. The refund is made to the payment method used, within fourteen days of the request.

sections.titre: 7. What the check-up is, and what it isn't
p: The check-up is a tool to help a couple talk about their life together. It isn't a diagnosis, a therapy or the opinion of a health professional. Decisions taken on the basis of the report remain the partners' own. If you're going through a difficult time, a couples counsellor or therapist can support you.

The service is provided as is. We do our best to keep it available at all times, but a temporary interruption (maintenance, a provider outage) can't be ruled out. If a paid report remains inaccessible through our fault, it is refunded.

The check-up answers, which may touch on intimate life and beliefs, are only saved with each partner's explicit consent and are only used for the check-up. How long they're kept, your rights and the list of providers are detailed in our {{confidentialite}}.
For any complaint, first write to us from the {{contact}} or at {{email}}: we reply within a few days.
If the disagreement continues, you can turn free of charge to the consumer mediator we belong to: {{mediateur}}, within one year of your written complaint.

p: These terms are governed by French law. If you live in another country of the European Union, you keep the protection of the mandatory rules of your country of residence.
